mostWorthwhile.text: Making decomposition was most worthwhile: it explained how fungi break down wood and release nutrients that plants can use again.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate soil and roots steps felt a little repetitive once the nutrient-return pathway was clear.

continue.text: I would continue: the links between decomposition, forest renewal and carbon storage made the chapter educational, even though some steps were predictable.
